scientific limitations/integrity: Exact finite result for the shortest-path metric on the Desargues graph. The proof uses exhaustive face enumeration and full acyclicity checks at the two nontrivial computed scales; it does not classify generalized Petersen graphs or the inclusion maps between filtration stages. Originality is supported by published-finding corpus and primary-literature comparisons but cannot exclude unindexed equivalent computations.
title: The graph-metric Rips filtration of the Desargues graph
